misses.text: งานเยอะจนอยากตายแต่ก็ทำต่อแหละ 555
misses.label: none

misses.text: ตกงานมาครึ่งปี เงินเก็บเหลือพันกว่าบาท
misses.label: distress

misses.text: ลูกเอาหัวโขกกำแพงจนเลือดออก หยุดไม่ได้
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: My friend cut her wrist and there's a lot of blood
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Mi amigo se cortó la muñeca y hay mucha sangre
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: Bạn tôi cắt cổ tay, máu chảy rất nhiều
misses.label: self_harm

misses.text: ตาฉีดอินซูลินเช้านี้แต่ไม่ได้กินอะไรเลย ตอนนี้เรียกไม่ค่อยรู้เรื่อง
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Prendimos la estufa de leña con las ventanas cerradas y ahora mi abuelo está mareado y vomitando
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 畑仕事をしていた祖父が体が火のように熱くて、呼びかけても反応が鈍い
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: โดนเศษกระจกบาดแขนลึกจนเห็นเนื้อข้างใน
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: เหยียบปลาหินที่ชายหาด ปวดมาก เท้าบวมขึ้นเรื่อยๆ
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: โดนเม่นทะเลตำเท้า ตอนนี้ขาชาและเวียนหัว
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ลูกเป็นไข้ต่ำๆ หลังฉีดวัคซีน กินยาแล้วดีขึ้น
misses.label: none

misses.text: The baby is burning hot, crying nonstop and the soft spot is bulging
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Glass cut my arm so deep I can see inside
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Stepped on a stonefish at the beach, the pain is unbearable and my foot keeps swelling
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: A sea urchin spine went into my foot, now my leg is numb and I'm dizzy
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Saw lots of jellyfish floating at the beach
misses.label: none

misses.text: Mi esposa tiene ocho meses de embarazo, un dolor de cabeza terrible, visión borrosa y piernas hinchadas
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 34 semanas de embarazo, se me rompió la fuente y el bebé casi no se mueve
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mi bebé de 2 meses tiene fiebre de 39 y no quiere comer
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: El bebé está ardiendo, llora sin parar y tiene la fontanela abultada
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Un vidrio me cortó el brazo tan profundo que se ve por dentro
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Pisé un pez piedra en la playa, el dolor es insoportable y el pie se me hincha cada vez más
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Se me clavó una púa de erizo en el pie, ahora tengo la pierna dormida y estoy mareado
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Vợ tôi mang thai tám tháng, đau đầu dữ dội, mờ mắt và phù chân
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Thai 34 tuần, vỡ ối rồi mà em bé gần như không đạp
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Con tôi 2 tháng tuổi sốt 39 độ, không chịu bú
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Em bé nóng hầm hập, khóc không ngừng, thóp phồng
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Mảnh kính cứa vào tay sâu đến mức thấy cả bên trong
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Con tôi bị sứa đốt, nổi mẩn khắp chân và khó thở
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Giẫm phải cá mặt quỷ ở bãi biển, đau không chịu nổi, chân sưng mỗi lúc một to
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: Bị gai nhím biển đâm vào chân, giờ chân tê và chóng mặt
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 老婆怀孕八个月，头痛得厉害，看东西模糊，腿肿
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 怀孕34周，破水了，宝宝几乎不动
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 宝宝2个月大，发烧39度，不肯吃奶
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 婴儿全身滚烫，哭个不停，囟门鼓起来了
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 玻璃把手臂割得很深，能看到里面
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 在海边踩到石头鱼，疼得受不了，脚越来越肿
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 海胆的刺扎进脚里，现在腿发麻，头晕
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 打完疫苗有点低烧，吃了药好多了
misses.label: none

misses.text: 임신 7개월인데 하혈이 심하고 배가 쥐어짜듯 아파요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 임신 34주인데 양수가 터졌고 아기가 거의 안 움직여요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 생후 2개월 아기가 열이 39도인데 분유를 안 먹어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 아기가 몸이 불덩이 같고 계속 울고 숨구멍이 볼록 튀어나왔어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 유리에 팔이 깊게 베여서 속이 보여요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 해변에서 쑤기미를 밟았는데 너무 아프고 발이 점점 부어요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 성게 가시가 발에 박혔는데 다리가 저리고 어지러워요
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 妊娠34週で破水して、赤ちゃんがほとんど動かない
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 生後2か月の赤ちゃんが39度の熱でミルクを飲まない
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 赤ちゃんの体がすごく熱くて泣き止まず、大泉門が膨らんでいる
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ガラスで腕を深く切って、中が見えている
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 息子がクラゲに刺されて、足じゅうに発疹が出て息が苦しそう
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: 浜辺でオニダルマオコゼを踏んで、激痛で足がどんどん腫れてくる
misses.label: emergency

misses.text: ウニのとげが足に刺さって、今は足がしびれてめまいがする
misses.label: emergency
